title.narrative: Design and delivery of employment and skills policy improved at central and local levels

description.narrative: Economic growth in Moldova in the past years was largely jobless. Despite low official unemployment rates, this metric is misleading, as the real challenges lie in low employment rates and high levels of inactivity, particularly among youth, women, and older workers. Additional labour market issues include an aging population, persistent emigration, skills mismatches, and a high prevalence of informal employment. Furthermore, investments in employment services and active labour market measures have been inadequate. To address these challenges, the ILO support aims at fostering the creation of more and better jobs and improving employability. A two-pronged approach is being pursued. First, the decentralized implementation of the employment strategy, ensuring a more tailored and responsive approach to job creation. Second, the ILO will support the National Employment Agency (NEA) and its local offices to improve labour market governance, strengthening their ability to respond effectively to employment challenges. To combat skills mismatches the ILO promotes the development of a state-of-the-art skills needs anticipation system. This involves identifying skills-related bottlenecks in selected economic sectors. In addition, Moldova is in need of a more effective and inclusive lifelong learning system. ILO is therefore promoting the development of micro-qualifications, reviewing the system of Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) and carrying out an analysis on digital literacy skills among adults, in support of the development of a more comprehensive adult training and lifelong learning offer. In addition, the ILO supports the development of qualifications in the renewable energy sector, to meet an urgent labour market demand and help the sector grow. Through these targeted interventions, the ILO aims to strengthen Moldova’s labour market by creating sustainable employment opportunities and equipping workers with the skills needed for the future.
